deploybot: [CI] Pipeline #8421 started for tag v2.14.0 (commit 9f3b2a7) on staging
alex: 👋 starting to watch. any known risks for this release?
maria: small dependency bump to tokenizer lib — should be fine but added in last-minute PR
ci-bot: Lint step running (eslint) -> node 18 image
deploybot: Lint step completed: FAILED
alex: ugh, lint? can someone paste the failure?
maria: pasting the top error:
```
client/src/generation/engine.ts:12:5 - error TS2322: Type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
  Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'.
```
kate: that's the new tokenizer change — TS strictness caught it. quick patch will be one line.
alex: ok do we want to fastpatch or pin the dependency and re-run?
maria: pin would be temporary but increases churn. fastpatch and re-run CI seems fastest given change window (we're in the morning window).
kate: +1 for fastpatch. I'll open a PR to default to empty string when undefined.
deploybot: Test step queued after lint fix PR merge -> will auto-trigger on merge to release branch
alex: if tests flake after that we should consider pin + backfill release notes explaining the change.
maria: noted. I'll also add a short note in the changelog entry to mention tokenizer behavior change.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by kate (PR #4982). Lint step started.
deploybot: Lint step completed: PASSED 
ci-bot: Unit tests starting (matrix: node18, python3.11)
alex: thumbs for quick validation :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Unit tests: FAILED (1 test)
ci-bot: Failing test: `generation/streaming.test.ts › streaming preserves token order`
maria: hmm that test can be timing sensitive. paste of the failing assertion:
```
Expected: ["hello"," world","!"]
Received: ["hello","!"," world"]
```
kate: that smells like a race introduced by tokenizer split change. I can reproduce locally. possible regression.
alex: given that, we should pause the release. do we have a hotfix plan?
maria: options: 1) revert tokenizer bump (fast but affects PR author), 2) patch streaming to be robust (safer but might take longer), 3) pin dep and delay release.
kate: I'm on it — starting a targeted hotfix branch to make the streaming behavior tolerant while we evaluate root cause. estimate 1-2 hours.
deploybot: Holding release pipeline per request from alex
alex: please @sre oncall if this will enter the change window boundary. we may need to shift release notes and schedule.
maria: pinging oncall in #eng-sre — brief summary and ETA
ci-bot: CI: rerun cancelled (pipeline held by manual action)
kate: will open PR for streaming tolerance + tests. I'll request expedited review from maria and alex.
alex: thanks. logging this decision: pause deploy -> hotfix branch -> run full CI -> if green, continue with release; if not, revert tokenizer bump and reassess.
maria: adding a short release note draft to the PR describing both the fix and rationale for the pause.
deploybot: Noted. Will post update when pipeline resumes or when a hotfix merge triggers a new pipeline.
ci-bot: Reminder: artifacts for pipeline #8421 will be retained for 72h due to manual hold.
alex: good catch team, keep updates in this thread. :eyes:
